### Meaning
| infl. | class  | meaning              |
| ----- | ------ | -------------------- |
| ~     | *n.*   | colour, hue, pigment |
| ~an   | *adj.* | colourful            |
### Implied meaning
- spectrum
- type
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- An eye ([[Sen'fi/Glossary/Body parts/mi\|mi]]) but the pupil is a triangle (like a prism) and a beam of light is going through it.
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Concepts/den\|den]]'s glyph is more about the straightness of light rays, whereas this one is about the light itself
#### Sound
- *a priori:* y=light, e=transition
